name: date-picker
useFor: Use DatePicker for one date (a key's expiry, when to send) and DateRangePicker for a period (the delivery log's range). Pass value and onValueChange, a placeholder, and presets for common choices (Today, Last 7 days). Pass calendar props such as disabled days through calendar. Give it a name to submit the date as YYYY-MM-DD with a form.
constraints: A text field people must type a date into
A range picker for a single date
Closing a range before both ends are picked
source: Extrapolated from the Inkbox console (Figma 427:2715): the select trigger (Any State) and the menu panel, with the calendar
title: Date Picker
description: The select trigger with a calendar glyph that opens the calendar in a white panel, for one date or a range, with optional presets.
